title: Crispy Fish Tacos
description: A delicious Mexican dish featuring crispy fish, topped with fresh ingredients and served in a crispy bowl.

ingredients.name: White Fish Fillets
ingredients.notes: Any white fish such as tilapia or cod works well

ingredients.name: Incredibly Crispy Tortilla Bowl
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or make your own

instructions: 2. Season the fish fillets with salt and a pinch of Syrian garlic.
3. Place the fish in a baking dish and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Place the crispy tortilla bowl in the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy.
6. Fill the crispy bowl with the cooked fish, crispy lettuce, and fresh cilantro.
